summary: Retested the fix for the promoted viewer's chat and reactions (stage.html:593 guard now accepts chiamataS === o.call; a failed-connection listener was added for the promoted call). The test used 3 browser contexts with fake media: viewer A, viewer B and the sender. All 12 checks passed: single-call chat both ways, guest chat and reaction before takeover, promotion of B after A hangs up, chat and heart reaction from promoted B reaching the sender, sender-to-B chat, and sender hangup ending B. No regressions found.
test_report_links: inline browser_automation script (multi-context async_playwright with fake media)
critical_code_review_comments: stage.html:593 guard (ospiti[code] !== o && chiamataS !== o.call) is correct. After promotion, the promoted dc has 2 data handlers: the addGuest one (chat/react/decline) and the promotion one (decline -> fineS). A decline after promotion runs togliOspite, which does nothing because the entry was deleted, and then fineS. This is harmless.
seed_data_creation: None. Chat messages prefixed TEST_ are ephemeral (P2P only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same approach as iteration 11: async_playwright inside browser_automation, launched with --use-fake-device-for-media-stream and --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream, with one new_context per page and an init script setting localStorage onboarded=true. Screenshots with quality need .jpg paths. Promotion status text on sender-status: 'Il visore principale ha chiuso: continui a trasmettere a <code>.'
rca_of_issue: Iteration 11 bug (promoted viewer chat/reactions dropped) is fixed and verified.
